posts.quote:
Not every hike
ends at the top.
Some end in a valley
full of quiet.

Rock, fog,
and the sound
of my own boots.
That's enough company.

The mist lifts
a little at a time.
So does whatever
I carried up here.

Grateful for early alarms,
warm layers,
and mornings
that look like this.

Snow on the peaks,
frost on the needles.
The whole valley
holding its breath.

A still lake
holds the whole mountain.
A quiet day
can hold a lot too.

The week was loud.
The pines were not.
Sunday, well spent.
